about_the_game:
Wander through a dreamlike world of color and calm.
Armed with a simple wand, you journey across rolling hills and glowing fields, where violet light meets drifting clouds. The world feels quiet, alive, and waiting.

To reach the final tower — a monument of shadow and mystery — you must awaken the four Elemental Towers scattered across the land. Each holds the essence of a natural force: Air, Earth, Water, and Fire.

There is no story to follow, no quest markers, and no time to race against. Only you, your wand, and the beauty around you. Cast elemental magic, restore balance, and lose yourself in a tranquil half-hour of light and sound.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: A short, relaxing first-person adventure. Explore a beautiful stylized world, harness the powers of air, earth, water, and fire, and confront the final tower to restore balance.
